notes.title: Temporary removal announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865856/2d3104b693eb555728580688091c6f854e412918.jpg[/img]

Dear friends from all walks of life:

        Since the "cutting edge record" released in 2020 December 29, we received many players express love, and to give us a lot of suggestions and feedback! I also saw that everyone is pouring their emotions into the current incomplete game, which made us far beyond our expectations. Thank you very much for your enthusiasm and love, thank you!

        Due to the review of the version number policy, "Feng Mang Lu" will be temporarily removed from STEAM China. There will be a temporary farewell for some time, at the end of the audit policy, we'll meet with you. This delisting will not affect the installed gamers, you can still find it from the [Library] of the STEAM client and start the game!

        During this time we will not stop the pace of research and development, hope next time on-line, to give players more richer gaming experience!
        Thanks for the support and encouragement since we agreed again, and we look forward to working with everyone reunited that day!

notes.title: 《锋芒录》今日正式上线！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865856/60515faab9d8357ca2a4f15af9fddba0609b1ca0.png[/img]

各种原因所致，《锋芒录》决定于今日发布早期版本。

《锋芒录》诞生的缘由，是出于寻找童年游戏时的那份感觉，我们希望能真正将精力放在游戏性上，而不是营收上；无奈研发之路几经坎坷，经历了版号、疫情、大改和资金问题，时至今日不得不以一个尚未成熟的姿态与诸位见面。

我们深知目前版本有所欠缺，将接受所有对于不足之处的批评。

因此，恳请再给予我们一些时间，我们将努力完善内容，将《锋芒录》打磨至其应有的程度，给诸位与我们自己一份交代。

另，无论好评差评，我们每条皆会认真阅读。

承蒙厚爱，不胜惶恐。

[list]
[*] [b]锋芒录官方QQ群：[/b]362060396
[/list]

notes.title: 非常抱歉，由于技术原因……预计延迟上线约一周时间
notes.notes:
《锋芒录》原定12月19日上线EA版，结果一切就绪之后才发现包体需要经过3至5天的审核方能发布。
初次使用Steam平台，有些规则没弄清楚，非常抱歉。
